P.A.TO JUDGE.
JUDGMENT

The petitioner was before this Court challenging Ext.P3 order, however the petitioner had also filed a statutory appeal from the stay order, which is said to have been rejected now, after filing of the writ petition.
In such circumstances, the petitioner would have to challenge the said Appellate Order as provided in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The writ petition is closed, leaving open such remedy.

K. VINOD CHANDRAN, JUDGE sp M/S.Safety Foods (Pvt.) Ltd vs Union Of India on 26 March, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11589294/
